description: This file defines a report class 'IssueAnalytics' for generating issue analytics reports within the ERPNext system, including methods for data retrieval, processing, and chart data preparation.

classes.name: IssueAnalytics
classes.description: A class for generating issue analytics reports, including data fetching, processing, and chart data preparation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that creates an IssueAnalytics instance and runs the report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the IssueAnalytics object with filters and prepares date ranges.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the report by getting columns, data, and chart data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns of the report based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches issues and prepares report rows.

methods.name: get_period
methods.description: Calculates period labels based on date and report range.

methods.name: get_period_date_ranges
methods.description: Generates date ranges for report periods based on selected range.

methods.name: get_issues
methods.description: Retrieves issues from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_common_filters
methods.description: Builds common filters for issue query.

methods.name: get_rows
methods.description: Constructs data rows for the report.

methods.name: get_periodic_data
methods.description: Aggregates issue data into periods and categories.
